exposure: rate of GWG in the 2nd and 3rd trimesters
cohort: Chinese urban women who delivered live singletons at ≥28 weeks of gestation (n=8926)
finding: Prepregnancy overweight, obesity and underweight, and insufficient and excessive rates of GWG were all associated with increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including cesarean delivery, preterm birth, SGA, and LGA.
mod_finding: Both excessive and insufficient rates of GWG were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
